summary: Require real Consultation owner acknowledgement for Teaching handoff by replacing local fake fallback with canonical create -> submit -> same-ID GET readback verification.

incident_context.symptom: When Teaching evaluation required consultation handoff but Consultation service was unwired, unauthenticated, or unavailable, TrainingConsultationClient returned a locally fabricated submitted receipt instead of surfacing a real owner boundary error, masking missing integration and leaving orphan receipts.
incident_context.root_cause: TrainingConsultationClient generated synthetic receipt IDs locally and swallowed exceptions with an unconditional status='submitted' fallback when base_url was unset or when remote calls failed. Furthermore, docker-compose.yml did not wire PANTHEON_CONSULTATION_API_URL or CONSULTATION_SERVICE_TOKEN to training-session-svc.
incident_context.resolution: Removed local fake fallback and exception swallowing in TrainingConsultationClient. Reused canonical ConsultationServiceClient with tenant and service bearer authentication to create (DRAFT) -> submit (SUBMITTED) -> GET readback verify owner acknowledgement. Deterministically scoped request ID to sha256(tenant_id:session_id:eval_id) to prevent duplicate creation on retry. Wired PANTHEON_CONSULTATION_API_URL and CONSULTATION_SERVICE_TOKEN into training-session-svc in docker-compose.yml.

acceptance_verification.ac1_canonical_owner_ack_and_no_fake_rece: passed: TrainingConsultationClient executes canonical create_request -> submit_request -> get_request verification. Missing base_url or owner failure raises ConsultationClientError fail-closed; no synthetic submitted receipt is returned.
acceptance_verification.ac2_protocol_reuse_and_scoped_request_id: passed: Reused ConsultationServiceClient with per-call X-Pantheon-Tenant-Id, Bearer token, and X-Pantheon-Service-Actor headers. Wired existing docker-compose env variables without creating new auth framework or schemas. Request ID is deterministically scoped as creq-teach-{sha256(tenant:session:eval)[:12]}.
acceptance_verification.ac3_real_http_boundary_and_rejection_tes: passed: Validated with in-process HTTP owner boundary running consultation service with auth required. Verified successful create/submit/readback flow and fail-closed rejections for absent wiring, missing auth token, invalid auth token, and remote error.
acceptance_verification.ac4_scoped_files_and_net_budget: passed: Exactly 7 declared files modified/created. Production code net line growth is 102 lines (docker-compose: +5, consultation/client.py: +39, training-session/consultation_client.py: +58), safely within the 120-line ceiling.

local_verification.result: passed (23 tests passed across 3 test suites in 17.32s)
